summary: Flat northern end of a parked-up residential kerb; homes 15-25 m away.

drivers.seclusion: Apartments 15 m away, a pool-side townhouse complex and a house 13 m south of the section. Trees screen the kerb from the east.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street, cars parked along the east kerb, so room to pull in.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street off a busier road at the north end.
drivers.convention: Cars park here, though 2P resident-permit signs apply Mon-Fri 7am-6pm.

flags: Slope steepens to 9.4% max further south; about 1.5% along best section
Gate 213 m away has a way round
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy over the north end of the kerb, shading it from the east and overhead.

best_section.where: East kerb of Brisbane Street, just south of the corner, under street trees
